title: Social Security disability application (adult): information and documents needed
use_when: The client is an adult applying for Social Security disability benefits.
note: Based on the SSA Adult Disability Starter Kit checklist (Publication 64-110, June 2024) and the SSA Checklist for Online Adult Disability Application (Publication 05-10519, July 2026). The responsible lawyer decides what the matter needs.

adult-kit.name: Social Security Administration, Adult Disability Starter Kit, Publication No. 64-110, June 2024

online-checklist.name: Social Security Administration, Checklist for Online Adult Disability Application, Publication No. 05-10519, July 2026

situations.born-outside-us: Was the applicant born outside the United States or its territories?
situations.non-citizen: Is the applicant not a U.S. citizen?
situations.children: Does the applicant have children who became disabled before age 22, are unmarried and under 18, or are 18 to 19 and in secondary school full time?
situations.military: Did the applicant serve in the U.S. military?
situations.self-employed: Was the applicant self-employed in the current year or prior 5 years?
situations.workers-comp: Does the applicant have a workers' compensation or other disability benefit claim?
situations.international-bank: Will benefits be deposited to a bank outside the United States?
situations.special-education: Did the applicant receive special education?

items.label: Date of birth, place of birth, and Social Security number
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Name of the birth country at the time of birth
items.detail: It may have a different name now.

items.label: Permanent Resident Card number
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Name, Social Security number, and date of birth or age of the current spouse and any former spouse(s)
items.detail: Also the dates and places of marriage and dates of divorce or death (if applicable). Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Names and dates of birth of children
items.detail: Children who became disabled prior to age 22, are under age 18 and unmarried, or are aged 18 to 19 and still attending secondary school full time.

items.label: U.S. military service: type of duty and branch, service period dates
Name, address, and phone number of two people who know about the medical conditions and can help with the claim
items.detail: If available. Other than healthcare providers.

items.label: Checking or savings account number and the bank's 9-digit routing number
items.detail: For electronic deposit of benefits. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: International direct deposit details
items.detail: Bank country, bank name, bank code, and currency; account type and number, branch/transit number. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Workers' compensation or other disability benefit information
items.detail: Including the date of injury, claim number, any settlement agreement details, and the source and payment amounts for any disability benefits.

items.label: Medical records already in the applicant's possession
items.detail: The applicant does not need to ask for or pay healthcare providers for any medical records they do not have.

items.label: Names, addresses, and phone numbers of healthcare providers that examined or treated the applicant
items.detail: For example doctors, psychiatrists, therapists, nurse practitioners, hospitals. The online checklist also asks for patient ID numbers and dates of examinations and treatments.

items.label: List of medicines taken and why
items.detail: For prescription medicines, include the names of the healthcare providers who prescribed them.

items.label: Names and dates of medical tests had or scheduled, and who ordered them
Other places that hold medical records
items.detail: Vocational rehabilitation services, workers compensation, public welfare, prison/jail, an attorney, or another place.

items.label: Date the medical condition began to affect the ability to work
List of the jobs held in the 5 years before becoming unable to work
items.detail: Dates (month and year) worked if known, average hours per day or week, how much was earned, and the types of duties for each job.

items.label: Employer details for the current year and prior 5 years
items.detail: Employer name, employment start and end dates, total earnings (wages, tips, etc.). Not self-employment.

items.label: Self-employment details for the current year and prior 5 years
items.detail: Business type and total net income.

items.label: Highest level of education completed, and when and where
Where and when special education was received
List of specialized job, trade, or vocational training and dates completed
